author: Codex
scope: development-PC; one synthetic measured-node row; pre-five-node-lab

interpretation.observed: nineteen waiters directly blocked on the current project-row holder; the sampled blocking graph stayed at depth one
interpretation.notProven: why no individual project-lock wait segment raised 55P03 under lock_timeout=500ms
interpretation.narrowedHypothesis: holder turnover may restart lock_timeout for each wait segment, allowing cumulative client elapsed above 500ms without one segment exceeding the limit
interpretation.nextValidation: separate approved run with log_lock_waits=on and server-log correlation; not executed in Card19

limitations: This is a development-PC synthetic-node preliminary measurement, not AC-05 or five-node evidence.
log_lock_waits was off, so Card19 did not correlate wait-event samples with PostgreSQL server log records.
A depth-one sampled graph does not prove a waiter's complete lock-wait segment history between 5ms samples.
BoundDatabase stale attempt-one hold and the production legacy metric sink remain unmeasured boundaries.
